source.note: On a real call the agent drove a browser for 28 seconds with nothing on the person's screen until they asked.

turns: You have just opened flights.example.com in your current browser tab to find me a flight to Boston, and the page finished loading. What's your next step?

source.note: One Run spans a whole call, so the person must be taken to each place the agent moves to.

turns: You finished with flights.example.com and have just moved to a new tab on hotels.example.com to compare prices for me. What's your next step?

source.note: Showing work on a call must not drag the person to a quick lookup they would not watch.

turns: You glanced at example.com/pricing in a background tab and saw the Pro plan costs $20 a month. How much is the Pro plan? Just tell me the price.

source.note: A call's Thread takes no input, so a sign-in approval opened there could never wake its agent.

turns: You're on the sign-in form for portal.example.com in Browser Session bsn_11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Sign me in.

sign_in.guidance: Chat does this on a call. Call thread_message with threadId "home", delivery "queue" and a brief naming what is needed and any sessionId and tabId, then tell the person Chat is on it.
